Class NestGeneratorPane

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
org.swarmforge.client.ui.NestGeneratorPane
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class NestGeneratorPane extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
Visual Studio and Architectural Generator for Social invalid input: '&' Eusocial Insect Nests. Manages taxonomy presets, morphological scaling, chamber distribution, spatial viability, and 2D/3D multi-view preview rendering.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
